questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Refute : Approve :: Admire : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Both words are antonyms.**

**Refute: Approve** → Refute is antonym of approve.

Similarly,

**Admire: ?** → Admire is antonym of criticize.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Criticize"**.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the

statements.

**Statements:**

Some words are short.

Some shorts are long.

All long are tree.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tree are short.

II. Some tree are words.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b072996b92045c9a488dffaeaf6bc70dd5fe9799d90bb77e8e0ec0b5bedef4d4.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tree are short. → **Follows** (As, some shorts are long and all long are tree)

II. Some tree are words. → **Not follow** (As, there is no definite relation between tree and words. Hence, false)

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusion I follows"**.

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row- 8, 96, 104

Second row- 11, 132, 143

Third row- 7, 84,?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** First number + Second number = Third number

First row- 8, 96, 104 → 8 + 96 = 104

Second row- 11, 132, 143 → 11 + 132 = 143

Similarly,

Third row- 7, 84,? → 7 + 84 = ?

⇒ 91 = ?

Hence, the correct answer is **"91"**.

questions.question: Seven students H, I, J, K, L, M and N have all scored unique number of marks. H scored only more than N. Marks of three students were between the marks of J and I. I did not score the highest marks. How many students scored less than J?
questions.solution:
As per the given information,

1) H scored only more than N.

_ > _ > _ > _ > _ > H > N

2) Marks of three students were between the marks of J and I.

3) I did not score the highest marks.

J > _ > _ > _ > I > H > N

Clearly, 6 students scored less than J.

Hence, the correct answer is **"6"**.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

483 ∶ 331 ∶∶ 715 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(Second Number) = (First Number) - 152**

Let's check as per the logic,

**483 ∶ 331** → 483 - 152 = 331

Similarly,

**715 ∶ ?** → 715 - 152 = 563

Hence, the correct answer is **"563"**.
